card.name: Words leading into secondary infection
card.fires_on: The word just before a likely 'secondary' or 'underlying' cause, such as 'a', 'possible', or 'secondary' itself. It appears in text about complications, infections or other conditions that follow or sit behind a first illness.

modes.label: Secondary infection
modes.description: The word 'secondary' or a lead-in to it, before infection terms.
modes.example: which can lead to a<< secondary>> skin infection.

modes.label: Lead-in to another cause
modes.description: A small word like 'a' or 'possible' before another condition to rule out.
modes.example: see your health care provider to rule out<< a>> sinus infection, allergies, or other medical

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing 'secondary' (and its Chinese equivalents) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up a 'secondary' problem, like a second infection after the first illness.
